contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ VICTORIAE LAETAE PRINC PERP ; D/ IMP CONSTANTIN[..]S [...]

A copper-alloy contemporary copy of a nummus of Constantine I, AD 306-337 (Reece period 16). Reverse legend reads VICTORIAE LAETAE PRINC PERP. Reverse shows Two Victories holding wreath, inscribed VOT PR, above altar. Prototype from mint of Trier. c. AD 318-320. Obverse legend reads IMP CONSTANTIN[..]S [...]. Obverse shows a helmeted and cuirassed bust right. Exergue reads: //STR. Die axis is 6…
